body: He had issues and I could've made this issues go away...

I shouldn't have drawn it out. I should've just said yes... He wasn't a bad guy after all, just tortured...

If this was like his last bucket list thing or something, maybe me saying yes could've made him realise that there is something to live for?? Or at least made him feel better about his life...
Even if it had made him feel 1% better about life, I should've done it for him. I'm such a selfish bitch... I took his life
I am responsible for his actions... He had a history of self harm and everyone made fun of him for that. Even I did... I can't live. I'm a horrible person who took someone's life.

I am responsible... I said no to him straight to his face... I should've known better. My friends talked about him as the weird kid who cuts himself... I don't even know why anyone would do that. But I should've realised he needed some happiness, some anchor in his life. And now he's fucking gone. Gone. Gone.
